Features

Clear Calls, Easy Content Sharing

Small and medium meeting rooms get video, audio and content sharing in a single certified kit.

Two 50MP Cameras

The XBar U50’s dual cameras deliver video at up to 3840 × 2160 with a 125° horizontal view.

AI Framing Tools

Auto framing, speaker tracking, smart gathering and intelligent focus follow the conversation.

12-Mic Array

Built-in MEMS microphones apply AI noise reduction, echo cancellation and gain control.

Dual 15W Speakers

Stereo, full-frequency speakers in the bar play remote participants’ voices.

4K Wired Sharing

Content shared through the XC25T HDMI input reaches up to 4K.

Wireless Sharing

Presenters can share in Teams Rooms from the MAXHUB Share app.

Overview

Fewer Cables, Simpler Installation

A single Ethernet cable links the XC25T mini-PC to the TCP30T console, and the XBar U50 connects to the mini-PC with a USB A-B cable. The mini-PC’s HDMI outputs support up to two room displays.

  • Windows 11 IoT Enterprise SAC and Microsoft Teams Rooms run on the mini-PC.
  • Laptops can share through the USB-C port on the console.
  • Pre-installed MAXHUB Pivot lets IT managers maintain and update the kit remotely.
  • An electric lens shutter on the XBar U50 closes automatically.
  • A PIR sensor on the console wakes it when people arrive.
What's in the Kit

Bar, Console & Compute Box

Each part ships in its own package with the cables it needs.

XBar U50 Video Bar

The 650.8mm bar weighs 2.68kg and carries the cameras, microphones and speakers.

In its box
  • Power adapter and 1.5m AC cable
  • 3m USB B-A cable
  • Remote control
  • Mounting components (ADA standard)
  • Positioning card

XC25T Mini-PC

This 1.12kg mini-PC runs Teams Rooms and outputs to the room displays over HDMI.

In its box
  • Wall mount kit
  • Two 3m HDMI cables
  • Power adapter
  • Power cable

TCP30T Touch Console

People join, call and share from an 11.6 inch capacitive touch screen.

In its box
  • 1.8m USB-C cable
  • 7.5m Ethernet cable

Room for a Second Console

The TCP30T has an RJ45 port for adding an optional second touch console.

FAQs

Common Questions on XT20-VB Kit

01What are the three parts of the XT20-VB Kit?

The kit is made up of the XBar U50 video bar, the XC25T mini-PC and the TCP30T touch console, each in its own package.

02Which room sizes is it designed for?

It is designed for small to medium meeting rooms.

03Is the kit certified for Microsoft Teams?

Yes. It is Microsoft Teams certified, and Teams Rooms runs on Windows 11 IoT Enterprise SAC on the mini-PC.

04How are the units connected?

The XBar U50 plugs into the mini-PC with a USB A-B cable, and one Ethernet cable links the console to the mini-PC. Room displays connect over HDMI.

05How many displays can be connected?

The mini-PC supports up to two room displays.

06How can people share content?

Content can be shared at up to 4K through the HDMI input on the mini-PC, from a laptop on the console’s USB-C port, or wirelessly with the MAXHUB Share app.

07Can a second console be added?

The TCP30T has an RJ45 port set aside for an optional second touch console.

08Which tools handle remote management?

MAXHUB Pivot is pre-installed for remote maintenance and updates, and the XBar U50 is controlled through MAXHUB Align.
